thread:
sophia: Quick heads-up — after the kernel-routing tweak yesterday I'm seeing a 20-40% tail latency bump on the private small-gpu VPC slices. Profiling attached.

ajay: Ugh. Any flamegraphs or traces? Is KV cache miss rate up?

sophia: Pasted flamegraph link: https://internal.ci/redwood/flame/195123 (private)
sophia: KV miss rate jumped from ~3% to ~12% under typical chat load. Batch size distribution shifted: median tok/batch 8 -> 3. Queue dwell time up ~30ms.

kevin: Do we have the batch-formation sampling logs? Might be the sampling rate change in continuous batching heuristics.

sophia: Here are the relevant knobs we tested on a canary slice:
```
continuous_batching.enabled: true
continuous_batching.sampling_rate: 0.06  # was 0.12
continuous_batching.token_target: 120
queue_policy: PRIORITIZE_LOWER_LATENCY
kv_cache.ejection_threshold: 0.75
kernel_selector.mode: 'latency_first'
```

lisa: That sampling_rate decrease could explain smaller batches. Why was it lowered?

ajay: It was to reduce overbatching on long-seq workloads but maybe aggressive for small-gpu constrained memory.

kevin: Two quick experiments: 1) bump sampling_rate back to 0.12 on private canary, 2) decrease token_target to 64 and enable kv_cache.proactive_prefetch: true. Can we try both in parallel?

sophia: Ran both. Results:
- sampling_rate 0.12: batch median back to 7, tail latency back near baseline but host CPU up ~10%.
- token_target 64 + prefetch: KV miss rate down to ~4%, but avg token cost per request increased slightly (more kernel switches).

lisa: Tradeoffs as expected. For constrained small-gpu VPC I'd prefer stable tail latency + lower KV misses. Maybe combine sampling_rate 0.09 + token_target 80?

ajay: Also noticed kernel_selector is doing more 'fallback' to generic kernels due to smaller batch lengths; consider adding a kernel routing override for private-smallgpu:
```
kernel_routing.overrides:
  private-smallgpu:
    prefer_kernels: [int8_stream, fused_attention]
    max_seq_len: 512
    allow_fallback: true
```

kevin: Agree. We should also add a short-circuit: if batch_tokens < 16, prefer low-latency kernel path even if less throughput efficient.

sophia: I'll push a canary with sampling_rate 0.09, token_target 80, kv prefetch=true and the kernel_routing override. infra-bot: please schedule canary on vpc-smallgpu pool.

infra-bot: Scheduled canary 1951234567-canary-3 on vpc-smallgpu-az2 -> start 1951234670

sophia: Canary results (after 1h): median batch tokens 6, p95 tail latency reduced ~18% vs regression, KV miss ~5.5%, host CPU up ~6%. No errors.

lisa: Sounds good. Can we add this as a default override in private deployment docs and a per-customer opt-in flag?

ajay: +1. Also add a note in the release that kernel selector changes require small-gpu perf tests with kv/miss profiles.

kevin: Filed PERF-3127 with the canary logs and config diffs.

sophia: Thanks all. I'll open the PR with the knob defaults and a short runbook for support teams.
